changelog:
Initial release of test-gen: generates unit and E2E tests for existing projects based on design docs and function signatures.

- Analyzes project environment, test coverage tools, and loads customizable coverage thresholds.
- Extracts project structure and business rules from design docs; summarizes findings for user confirmation.
- Performs black-box analysis of public APIs, infers test dimensions, and reports results.
- Reviews testability of each function, identifying design issues and skipping non-testable or trivial code.
- Generates targeted, high-quality tests for "testable" APIs, then runs tests and reports coverage, highlighting both overall and diff-line metrics.
- Integrates with git and common coverage tools; supports both project-level and user-level installation.
summary: 为已有项目生成单元测试和 E2E 测试。分析设计文档和函数签名（黑盒）， 评审可测试性设计缺陷，生成测试代码并产出覆盖率报告。 Use when: "generate tests", "add tests", "补测试", "生成单测", "write unit tests", "add e2e tests",...
